symbols.name: eigenvalue
symbols.meaning: A scalar in F for which the operator T maps some nonzero vector e to the multiple θe.
symbols.quote: Write $\theta$ for the eigenvalue, a scalar in $F$.

symbols.name: operator space
symbols.meaning: The vector space on which the linear operator T acts.
symbols.quote: Write $V$ for the vector space on which the operator $T$ acts.

symbols.name: eigenvector
symbols.meaning: A nonzero vector of V that the operator T maps to a multiple of itself.
symbols.quote: Write $e$ for an eigenvector, a nonzero vector of $V$.

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.meaning: The h by h matrix with every entry equal to 1.
symbols.quote: Let $J$ be the $h\times h$ matrix with every entry equal to $1$, the all-one matrix.

symbols.name: all-one vector
symbols.meaning: The vector in Q^h whose entries are all equal to 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathbf{1}$ be the vector in $\mathbb{Q}^h$ with every entry equal to $1$.

symbols.name: zero-sum vector
symbols.meaning: A vector in Q^h whose entries sum to zero.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be any vector in $\mathbb{Q}^h$ whose entries sum to zero.

relations.predicate: is stated in the language of
relations.quote: An eigenvalue is stated in the language of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md): a linear operator $T$ on a vector space $V$ over $F$ has eigenvalue $\theta$ when $Te = \theta e$ for some nonzero $e$ in $V$.
